title: Better Arrow Crosshair
description: This adds a arrow crosshair. Very nice for PVP.
body:
# **CROSSHAIR**


This adds a arrow crosshair. That's it. Hope you have fun with it! It probably won't help with PVP since it's so **BIG**.

![Crosshair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5aab1dc148e33f857c00e5ee2c755587a42ad1e4.png)


You can send this to your friends or just download it yourself for fun and laughs! (or you might just like the crosshair. I'm not judging.)
